reason: node-forge <=1.4.0 RSA signature-verification flaw; no patched release is available as of 2026-10-02. Present only in word-addin devDependencies through office-addin-dev-certs -> mkcert and office-addin-debugging -> @microsoft/teamsfx-core. Their local certificate helpers generate/sign certificates and parse local key/certificate files; they do not call the vulnerable signature verifier. The production add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs, not these development dependencies. REMOVE WHEN: node-forge publishes a patched release and these chains can resolve it; reassess if the dependency gains a production or signature-verification caller.

tmp 0.0.33 path traversal via prefix/postfix, reachable in word-addin only through @inquirer/editor -> external-editor, i.e. the interactive prompts of @microsoft/teamsapp-cli under office-addin-debugging — a devDependency, and the prefixes are literals inside that CLI rather than anything this repo or a document supplies. Same downgrade-only 'fix' as adm-zip above. REMOVE WHEN: external-editor resolves tmp >0.2.5 (or the teamsapp-cli chain drops external-editor) inside office-addin-debugging's declared range.

braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested brace patterns; published 2026-09-18 and no patched release exists (3.0.3 is the latest braces). Present only in devDependencies: frontend through @ladle/react -> globby -> fast-glob -> micromatch, and word-addin through webpack-dev-server -> http-proxy-middleware -> micromatch (`npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty in every workspace). Those callers expand glob and proxy-path patterns written in this repo's own config, never user or document input, and neither tool ships in a production image. REMOVE WHEN: braces publishes a patched release (or micromatch drops braces) and these chains resolve it; reassess if braces gains a production caller.
